brief:
Israeli forces demolished the home of a Palestinian who died in a deadly West Bank confrontation in July, according to residents and the army, Al-Monitor reported. The clash occurred on July 24 when Israeli settlers approached a town in the occupied territory, resulting in one of the deadliest incidents in months in the region.

The demolition took place Tuesday, targeting the residence of the slain Palestinian. Israeli authorities have long used home demolitions as a policy tool in the occupied West Bank, citing security reasons for the practice. The July 24 clash marked a significant escalation in violence between settlers and Palestinians in recent months.

title: Israel demolishes home of Palestinian killed in July West Bank clash
